text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Special Week misses her training. It's
nighttime
when I finally get ahold of her.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I'm so sorry I couldn't make it to training!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Actually, Suzuka had a race today, and I
really
wanted to watch her run, so...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
choice_data_list: まあ、観戦も勉強になるし
choice_data_list_en: Well, spectating is a good learning experience too.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I realized her Runaway method is
something that
no one else can imitate.
choice_data_list: スズカの走りは参考になったか？
スズカの走りは参考になった？
choice_data_list_en: Did watching Suzuka run give you any pointers?
Did watching Suzuka run give you any pointers?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I can't help but wonder whether she
really learned
anything if the method
can't be imitated.
